title: Discrete quadrature spectrum of composite bosons: code, data and manuscript sources
description: Code, data and manuscript sources for the paper Discrete quadrature spectrum of composite bosons: Weyl relation, intensity correlations, and binned homodyne detection (I. Roditi). The scripts compute, for an exactly solvable two-fermion composite boson with a finite Schmidt spectrum, the Weyl (displacement) defect, periodically binned homodyne quadratures and the exact Pauli algebra and singlet recovered from them, and intensity correlations; the JSON files are the archived scans; every table and figure block of the manuscripts is regenerated from them by code/make_assets.py, and reproduce.sh runs the tests and the independent cross-checks.
